Question: An autopsy is being performed on an elderly man who died from a myocardial infarction. Biopsy of the heart is likely to reveal necrosis most similar to necrosis seen in which of the following scenarios?

Options:
opa. The central nervous system following a stroke
opb. The lung following a tuberculosis infection
opc. Acute pancreatitis resulting from release of enzymatically active enzymes into the pancreas
opd. A region of kidney where blood flow is obstructed
ope. An abscess
